Text works with replies, reactions, editing and deleting, and so do pictures, videos, voice messages and files – checked for malware like your own.
What does not work here: calls, status, disappearing messages and GateControl extras such as polls, events, home actions, cards and sending a location.
The other messenger does not take this kind of file. Pictures as JPEG, PNG or WebP, videos as MP4, voice messages as OGG, M4A, AAC or MP3.
Chats with the service’s contacts appear in your chat list as soon as a new message arrives there – older history is not loaded. Texts, pictures, videos, voice messages and files go both ways.
